footnote_text: Reference is made to that certain Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of February 9, 2026 (the "Merger Agreement"), by and among Silvia, Inc., a Delaware corporation (formerly known as ProCap Financial, Inc.) (the "Issuer"), Silvia Merger Sub, Inc. ("Merger Sub"), CFO Silvia, Inc. (the "Target"), Shain Noor, an individual, Inflection Points Inc d/b/a Professional Capital Management, a Delaware corporation ("Inflection Points"), and Shain Noor, solely in his capacity as stockholder representative. Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, on April 6, 2026, Merger Sub merged with and into the Target, with the Target surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer (the "Merger"). || Represents shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of the Issuer ("Common Stock") received by Inflection Points in connection with the Merger, consisting of 3,787,094 shares of Common Stock issued at the closing of the Merger and 453,426 shares of Common Stock deposited into an escrow account with PNC Bank, N.A. (the "Escrow Shares"). The 453,426 Escrow Shares are held in escrow for the benefit of Inflection Points to secure indemnification obligations under the Merger Agreement and may be voted, but may not be transferred, by Inflection Points while held in escrow. In addition, the Escrow Shares are subject to transfer restrictions under a lock-up agreement dated April 6, 2026, by and among Inflection Points, the Issuer, and the other parties thereto. || Anthony Pompliano (the "Reporting Person") is the founder and Chief Executive Officer of Inflection Points. Accordingly, the Reporting Person shares voting and dispositive power over the securities held by Inflection Points.

Reference is made to that certain Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of February 9, 2026 (the "Merger Agreement"), by and among Silvia, Inc., a Delaware corporation (formerly known as ProCap Financial, Inc.) (the "Issuer"), Silvia Merger Sub, Inc. ("Merger Sub"), CFO Silvia, Inc. (the "Target"), Shain Noor, an individual, Inflection Points Inc d/b/a Professional Capital Management, a Delaware corporation ("Inflection Points"), and Shain Noor, solely in his capacity as stockholder representative. Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, on April 6, 2026, Merger Sub merged with and into the Target, with the Target surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer (the "Merger"). || Represents shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of the Issuer ("Common Stock") received by Inflection Points in connection with the Merger, consisting of 3,787,094 shares of Common Stock issued at the closing of the Merger and 453,426 shares of Common Stock deposited into an escrow account with PNC Bank, N.A. (the "Escrow Shares"). The 453,426 Escrow Shares are held in escrow for the benefit of Inflection Points to secure indemnification obligations under the Merger Agreement and may be voted, but may not be transferred, by Inflection Points while held in escrow. The shares of Common Stock issued at the closing of the Merger and the Escrow Shares are subject to transfer restrictions under a lock-up agreement dated April 6, 2026, by and among Inflection Points, the Issuer, and the other parties thereto.
